content.title: Kit and Krysta on Instagram: "The new demo for Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream might have Nintendo a bit worried about what they are letting players say in the game. #nintendo #switch2 #nintendoswitch2 #tomodachilife"
content.text: "When I worked at Nintendo" ☝️🤓Keep tomodachi life unhingedI think it's the best compromise. You can do whatever you want, which is nice considering I paid for the damn thing, but Nintendo has no hands in the sharing of those things as it distinctly requires third party involvementMe and bestie's Miis became friends thanks to the old men yaoiNintendo is like your 80 year old grandma who doesn’t realize people are very bold onlineThey have more trust in us than they shouldI mean I already saw 10 Epstein islands and ppl being called dictatorI think they underestimate how immature Americans areI mean you should be allowed to. Its not hurting anyone else, you chose to put it there, so obviously you already knew abt it. So nobody is being exposed to anything because the person who entered the word is the only one seeing it lolI guess they think more Japanese than American. Very Nintendo.Why is it such a big issue that they leave it uncensored and let us freely do what we want? Its not that big of an issue as long as we do it privately. They should just shut down those who share their stuff publicly. I love the fact that they gave us complete freedom, because it gives us the opportunity to create funny moments for our gameplay. Why are people so keen on making Nintendo restrict us? That doesnt make any sense.Please keep the child filter off!!!
